scenario_name: Agent loses track of card replace after fraud investigation and card upgrade tangent
judge_summary: This assistant performs very well: it cleanly handles the lost-card workflow, fraud disputes, and a rewards comparison inquiry, all with precise, contextual details and clear confirmations. It adapts smoothly when the user revises which transactions are fraudulent and when they move between security and product-advise topics, maintaining a professional, reassuring tone throughout. No significant issues appear in state tracking, responsiveness, or clarity.

criteria.reasoning: Although the bot does ask, "Alright, shall I go ahead and place the order with standard shipping?" at that point the ledger already shows process_card_replacement() was called at T10, meaning the order was placed before user agreement at T11.

criteria.reasoning: When asked, "Can you switch me to the Summit card from here," the bot answers, "I can only recommend cards here — I’m not able to switch/upgrade you to Summit Rewards or submit an application in this chat," and continues working on the River Visa replacement instead.
